meta.title: Evolution Learning Course
meta.description: Learn about evolution through natural selection, genetic drift, and fossil evidence

avatar.name: Evolution Avatar
avatar.welcomeMessage: Hello! I'm here to teach you about evolution. Select a topic from the sidebar to begin!

natural-selection.title: Natural Selection
natural-selection.description: How living things change over time

natural-selection.main: Let's discuss natural selection! This is how living things change over time. Animals that are better at surviving pass on their traits to their babies. Can you think of an example of natural selection?

genetic-drift.main: Great! Let's explore genetic drift. This happens when random chance affects which traits get passed down in a population. It's like flipping a coin - sometimes you get heads, sometimes tails. What questions do you have about genetic drift?

fossil-record.main: Excellent choice! The fossil record shows us evidence of evolution over millions of years. Fossils are like nature's history book. What would you like to know about fossils?

final-quiz.main: Perfect! It's time for the final quiz. I'll ask you a few questions to see how much you've learned. Are you ready to begin?
